transactions.name: UpdItmBasic
transactions.description: Update Item Basic Information (MITMAS). Optional fields are applied only when supplied non-blank; omitted fields leave existing M3 values unchanged.

transactions.name: AddItmViaItmTyp
transactions.description: Add Item via Item Type — creates MITMAS record using an item type template (preferred for new items; pre-populates product group, procurement group, UoM and other defaults from the item type definition)

fields.name: ITTY
fields.description: Item Type — drives default population of classification fields

fields.name: UNMS
fields.description: Basic Unit of Measure (MITMAS.MMUNMS) — defaults from item type if omitted

responseFields.name: MSID
responseFields.description: Message ID — blank = success; non-blank = error code

transactions.name: AddItmBasic
transactions.description: Add Item Basic — creates MITMAS record without an item type template. Use AddItmViaItmTyp when an item type is available; use this only when no applicable item type exists.

responseFields.name: MSID
responseFields.description: Message ID — blank = success; non-blank = error code

transactions.name: AddItmFac
transactions.description: Add Item Facility — creates the facility-level record in MITFAC. Must be called after AddItmViaItmTyp or AddItmBasic; item cannot be used at a facility until this record exists.

fields.name: ITNO
fields.description: Item Number — must already exist in MITMAS

responseFields.name: MSID
responseFields.description: Message ID — blank = success; non-blank = error code

transactions.name: AddItmWhs
transactions.description: Add Item Warehouse — creates the warehouse-level record in MITWHL. Called after AddItmFac; required before warehouse transactions (receipts, issues, balances) can reference the item.

fields.name: ITNO
fields.description: Item Number — must already exist in MITMAS and MITFAC for this facility

responseFields.name: MSID
responseFields.description: Message ID — blank = success; non-blank = error code

transactions.name: UpdItmWhs
transactions.description: Update Item Warehouse (MITBAL). Optional fields are applied only when supplied non-blank; omitted fields leave existing M3 values unchanged.

fields.name: NUIN
fields.description: Number of records for physical inventory

fields.name: DILE
fields.description: Projected on-hand at end of lead time
